diagnostics.message: The EventBridge target can become active before its Lambda invoke permission exists. The schedule may fire during that interval, causing an invocation to be denied; make the target wait for the corresponding permission.
The EventBridge target can become active before its Lambda invoke permission exists. A scheduled invocation in that interval can be denied; order target creation after the corresponding permission.
The EventBridge target can become active before its Lambda invoke permission exists. A scheduled invocation in that interval can be denied; order target creation after the corresponding permission.

The SQS event source mapping can begin polling and invoking the scale-up Lambda as soon as it is enabled, but the Lambda execution role's SQS permissions are provisioned by this inline policy. Ensure the mapping is not enabled before those permissions are attached.

With auto_deploy enabled, the API Gateway stage can expose the webhook route before the Lambda resource policy allows API Gateway to invoke the function. Order stage deployment after the webhook invoke permission to avoid requests failing during setup.

This object is intentionally uploaded after the S3 notification to trigger the syncer immediately, but the Lambda can run before its S3 access policy has been installed. Make the trigger upload wait until the syncer role policy is in place.

The scheduled syncer can be invoked as soon as this EventBridge target is installed, while its S3 access policy is still being applied. Ensure the target is not activated until the syncer execution policy is ready.
The scheduled scale-down Lambda can run as soon as this target is installed, but its execution permissions are supplied by this inline policy. Order target activation after the policy is ready.
A pool schedule may invoke the Lambda immediately after this target is created, before its execution policy is applied. Order target activation after the pool inline policy is ready.

The API stage exposes the webhook route, allowing Lambda invocation, but the handler's SQS publishing permissions are provided by this inline policy. Ensure the stage is not exposed before this policy is ready.

The API stage exposes the webhook route, allowing Lambda invocation, but the handler's permission to read the GitHub webhook secret is provided by this inline policy. Ensure the stage is not exposed before this policy is ready.
